item.title: azure: Announcing: New Windows App client-side endpoints for Azure Virtual Desktop
item.description:
Windows App will start using three new wildcard FQDNs for client-side service traffic to Azure Virtual Desktop beginning in early October 2026. The domains are already part of the cloud-side connectivity requirements.

  • Source: Azure Updates
